seed-generation.selected_problem: Mining-frigate threat, defense, and retreat supervision

designer-initial.summary: Selected a bounded seven-responsibility abstract with 13 interactions, 11 complete cases, five scenario families, and one decision owner.
questions_for_model: Can the selected qualifier and execution duties realize 13 end-to-end semantic interactions with traceable concrete routing without counting routing hops as new semantic interactions?
Can one principal owner express and typecheck prior-phase state plus 11 mutually exclusive, exhaustive, complete-output GUMBO cases without relying on unsupported first-match semantics?
Can the retained bounded analyzer evidence every admissible phase/progress and validity combination, exact input-fault equivalence, and retreat/service recovery composition?

model-review.summary: Clarify trace-anchor syntax and the phase/progress admissibility relation; ALT-01 and all calibrated behavior remain unchanged.

findings.evidence: The current SysML-viz abstract parser accepts paired declaration IDs only in `ID / ID:` form. Parsing the initial abstract recognizes 97 anchors but none of CASE-01..CASE-11, FAULT-01..FAULT-03, or BEH-01..BEH-08 because their eleven declarations use `ID ID:`; tracing those clauses would create unresolved IDs.
findings.requested_change: Change only the eleven declaration prefixes to `FAULT-01 / CASE-01:` or `BEH-nn / CASE-nn:` form; preserve every identifier, guard, result, order, and count.

findings.evidence: CONS-05 does not independently enumerate admissible phase/service-progress pairs. Its phrase `docked progress with retreat, service, or Fault_Hold recovery` can admit Retreating with Offload_Confirmed or Resupply_Confirmed, while CASE-07 and CASE-08 exclude Retreating, producing bounded-analysis gaps; deriving admissibility from the case union would make the exhaustiveness test circular.
findings.requested_change: Make CONS-05 explicit: Away permits Idle/Mining/Defending/Retreating/Fault_Hold; At_Station permits Retreating/Fault_Hold; Docked_Loaded permits Retreating/Servicing/Fault_Hold; Offload_Confirmed and Resupply_Confirmed permit Servicing/Fault_Hold, applying independently of validity. Change no PART, INT, metric, case output, priority, recovery, or claim-boundary choice.

findings.evidence: Library commit 9016cbcceefa92f0068e1811923704dd261d15f1 provides System, Process, Thread, structured Data, directed typed DataPort, and PortConnection. Sireum v4.20260630.386eac9f typechecked the repository-configured trusted Isolette source with this library at exit 0 and `Well-formed!`, including System/Process/Thread containment and boundary/process/thread routing.
findings.requested_change: Retain ALT-01. Realize one root System, one behavior-free support Process, and seven semantic Threads at depth 2; treat support routing hops as traced refinements of INT-01..INT-13, not additional semantic interactions.

findings.evidence: Current trusted GUMBO syntax supports local state, initialize guarantees, and compute cases, but compute cases are conjunctive rather than first-match. The eleven ordered cases are expressible using explicit mutually exclusive predicates and complete five-output conjunctions on the sole PART-01 owner; qualifier and executor identity guarantees remain local non-case preservation obligations.
findings.requested_change: During generation, encode every `no earlier case` exclusion explicitly and do not rely on textual case order or count pass-through identity guarantees as nontrivial cases.

findings.evidence: The unfiltered finite domain contains 4,976,640 snapshots, and the required analyzer is a deterministic dependency-free enumerator with a 180-second harness watchdog. After the admissibility clarification, it can independently check the named local relations, explicit interaction map, exclusivity, exhaustiveness, five-output completeness, fault equivalence, and five bounded scenario families without expanding the run's claim boundary.
